cases.sentence: В полночь он встал, схватил двери ___ вместе с обоими косяками и вырвал их вместе с засовом.
cases.explain: «городских ворот» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.

cases.sentence: Тогда правители филистимлян принесли ей семь ___, которые еще не высохли, и она связала его.
cases.explain: «сырых тетив» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

cases.sentence: Уперевшись в один из них правой, а в другой — ___, 30 Самсон сказал:
cases.explain: «левой рукой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.
